name: tpl-precedence-3-goal
task: Pick up the box in the other room, but do not drop the key while the door is closed until the door has been opened once.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: the second clause is too strict for the stated ban. The task says "do not drop the key while the door is closed until the door has been opened once". With key_lost defined as the drop-while-door-closed event, "until the door has been opened once" makes the ban lift after the first opening, i.e. key_lost must not happen before door_open. The candidate uses a hard Absence(key_lost), which forbids dropping the key while the door is closed forever, even after the door has been opened once. Replace the hard Absence(key_lost) with a hard Precedence(door_open, key_lost). The hard Existence(target_picked_up) is correct.

texts: Pick up the target box in the other room
Do not drop the key while the door is closed until the door has been opened once
